auth_type.correction: bearerToken for the ATS API, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>; the Careers Site API requires no authentication

free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable because there is no ongoing free tier. The 18-day free trial allows at most 5 published jobs and 50 emails and does not allow promotion on free job boards.

rate_limits.correction: 1000 requests per minute per API token

notes: Official documentation contradicts the stated authentication, rate-limit, and example fields. ATS calls require a company-scoped path and Bearer token. Recruitee offers an 18-day trial rather than a continuing free plan, and its trial limits are published. No authoritative CORS policy was located.
